items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: Actually the original band was great, it originally was Don Pullen on piano, we had Buster Williams on bass and we had Idris Muhammad in the rhythm section.

ctx.x: What’s coming up in the near future? McCoy you said?

McCoy, yeah, next month. And then I have a tour, I’m taking my band to Europe in March-April, the end of March and April. I’m doing a tour in Canada and the U.S. with a guy named Franco Ambrosetti, an Italian trumpeter and myself and it’s going to be Buster Williams will be drumming. That’s in June. And then I go to tour, a big festival tour with McCoy Tyner in July. So those are some of the things as far as playing. I’m also involved in some projects, I’m waiting on a project — I write for film.
